title: Annex A.10 - Third-party and customer relationships
description: Working paper for Annex A.10: supplier relationships, customer responsibilities, allocation of responsibilities.

sections.title: Supplier management (A.10.2)
prompts: Confirm AI suppliers are identified and onboarded with due diligence.
Verify contractual flow-down of AIMS obligations.

sections.title: Customer responsibilities (A.10.3)
prompts: Confirm communication of customer responsibilities (e.g., not to misuse, to provide quality data).

sections.title: Allocation of responsibilities (A.10.4)
prompts: Verify a responsibilities matrix between auditee and customers / suppliers.
Sample two contracts and confirm matrix alignment.

checklists.text: AI supplier register up to date.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: Walk us through onboarding a new AI model supplier.
Show us where customer responsibilities are stated.
How are responsibilities allocated when an incident spans you and a customer?
